description.text: The ADSP Project Planner guides you through a structured conversation to identify which ADSP platform services best support your business problem. You will describe your business situation, and the AI Planning Agent will ask clarifying questions, extract business concepts, and generate a solution hypothesis recommending the right ADSP services for your context. Your progress is automatically saved so you can pause and resume across work days.

alert.heading: Planning Agent is in test mode
alert.body: The AI Planning Agent (INT-001) is currently operating in stub mode pending contract approval for the Anthropic Claude API (OPEN-001, OPEN-002, OPEN-006). In this mode, the agent will not process your business problem description or generate concept extractions. You can still navigate the planning workspace and familiarize yourself with the interface. Messaging will resume when the integration is activated.

serviceInfo.heading: Estimated time
serviceInfo.value: Approximately 30 minutes for an initial business problem description. You can pause and resume at any time.

serviceInfo.heading: Auto-save
serviceInfo.value: Your progress is saved automatically after each Planning Agent response. You will not lose work if you close the browser.

serviceInfo.heading: Output format
serviceInfo.value: At the end of your session you can export a structured JSON document containing your business model, accepted solution hypothesis, and implementation recommendations.

preparation.heading: Before you begin
preparation.intro: To get the most value from your planning session, have the following ready before you start:

items.label: Business problem statement
items.detail: A plain-language description of the problem your program or service is trying to solve. It does not need to be technical — describe it from the perspective of the affected users or program staff.

items.label: Stakeholder context
items.detail: Who are the main actors involved? Include both internal GoA staff and external clients or partners who interact with the business process.

items.label: Known constraints
items.detail: Any policy, regulatory, budget, or timeline constraints that the solution must respect.

items.label: Estimated scope
items.detail: A rough sense of the scale — is this a single form and approval workflow, a multi-step service delivery process, or something larger?

sessionTitleForm.heading: Name your session
sessionTitleForm.intro: Give this planning session a title that will help you identify it in your session list.

fields.label: Session title
fields.name: title
fields.errorMessage: Enter a session title between 1 and 200 characters.

mongoErrorBanner.heading: Unable to create session
mongoErrorBanner.body: The planning session could not be created due to a system error. Please try again in a moment. If this problem persists, contact ADSP Support.

onSubmit.description: Create a new planning session with the provided title. Persists PlanningSession in MongoDB with status active, linked BusinessModel, and publishes session-created domain event via INT-007 stub.

securityNotes.fieldMasking: Session title input is sanitized server-side via Zod schema validation (SYSREQ-024). XSS payloads in session title are stripped at the API layer before persistence (TC-051).
